name: Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar (Plain Slices)
whyItWorks: Plain milk chocolate has lower caffeine and theobromine than dark chocolate, and melts at body temperature without nuts or seeds. Provides quick comforting sweetness in deep remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Break off 2–3 rectangular pips (about 15–20g). Let melt slowly on the tongue rather than chewing rapidly.
watchOuts: Contains milk and cocoa butter; excessive amounts can trigger diarrhea in flare-ups.
